Landed on branch feat/rfc-050-blob-done, commit ce0feca.

BLOB_DONE (0x20) implemented in lib/slopsync/include/slopsync/wire/raw/
blob_done.hpp (7 B raw: BLOB_CHUNK's 6-byte identity prefix verbatim +
status u8). Hub: §8.4 rows 2-4 -- in-flight budget capped at
limits::blob_chunks_in_flight while congested, reset on recovery (row 3),
and a lack-of-progress stall clock that aborts once with NACK BUSY +
retry_after_ms after 5 s (row 4). Row 1's retry-at-the-refused-index was
already correct in Slot::PendingBlob and is unchanged. HubDelegate::
onBlobDone added, observability only, no-op default. Receivers emit it:
C++ Client, clients/js/session.js, tools/slopscope.py.

EVIDENCE: pio test -e native, 18 suites PASSED exit 0 (17 before). New
suite test_slopsync_blobdone BD-01..BD-06, 6 cases / 68 assertions run
direct from .pio/build/native/program.exe (T10). node clients/js/test/
slopsync-wire.test.mjs ALL PASS. K-01/K-02 unmoved (775 B /
F4A28FBB58CED16A still pinned green in test_slopsync_catalog).

FOLLOW-UP FOR THE RFC GATE, not done from an implementation commit:
SPEC §18-24 item 24 still ends "Still not shipped: the hub does not abort
a sustained-congestion transfer with NACK BUSY, and no reference client or
hub emits BLOB_DONE" -- now false. registry.yaml's frame_types 0x20 note
still ends "Implementation: Phase D (post-batch hub work)". Both are
normative surfaces and need an RFC-gated edit.

DEVIATION WORTH A RULING: §8.4 row 4 keys the abort on the §10.3
congestion signal being sustained. The implementation keys it on LACK OF
PROGRESS instead (no chunk emitted for 5 s, whether from the in-flight
budget or a transport refusal). Reason: a binding whose adapter never
calls setCongestionLevel() -- which is every binding that has not opted in,
including the in-process one -- would otherwise hold a dead transfer
forever. Wider than the letter of the table, and it subsumes it.

RFC-060 ACCEPTED and LANDED 2026-09-21 in the single atomic rename commit. Operator overrode the 'land after val-091.13' sequencing note with the 2026-09-21 ruling. IANA check: port 22096 unassigned, proposed value stands. Consumer pin bumps (ValenceDrive) are that repo's work.
